decisionsTitle: A simple volunteer agreement, approved by the club and accepted by every volunteer
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13 ~23:20, right after the volunteers shipped (§754):** «trebuie să avem și un document gen „contract de voluntariat” simplu, unde zicem că nu sunt plătiți, că trebuie să respecte atribuțiunile, bla bla bla». Romania's volunteering law (Legea nr. 78/2014) asks for a written agreement between the host organisation and each volunteer; §754 listed people with nothing signed. Amends §754.

**Decision.** A seventh legal text of the platform, `VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT` («Contract de voluntariat» / “Volunteer agreement”), built and approved exactly as the declarations are (§29, §95, §418, §515, §639): a Romanian and an English template in `legal-documents/templates/volunteer-agreement.ts`, the club named only by its four `<PLACEHOLDER>`s (§132), «Regenerează din șablon» and the one press on `/admin/legal`, a version fixed by its hash, the sample banner everywhere but production (the seed approves a sample on dev and QA, and is still refused production), the «Șablon nou» email of §639 when the template moves. Its words, plain: the parties; the activity — the event, its date and place, the role and what it asks; unpaid, no employment, costs announced beforehand are not pay; the volunteer's duties (the role's tasks, the organizers' instructions, safety and the event's rules, the confidentiality of the participants' data seen at the desk, telling the organizers when they cannot come); the club's duties (information about the role and its risks, the means, a contact on the day, a volunteer certificate on request); duration; ending by either side at any time; a pointer to the privacy notice; Legea nr. 78/2014. One text serves every event and role: `{{volunteer}}`, `{{volunteerRole}}`, `{{volunteerTasks}}` (a role with no description leaves its sentence out), `{{event}}`, `{{eventDate}}`, `{{eventLocation}}`, `{{minimumAge}}` and `{{signedAt}}` are filled when a person accepts.

**Accepted before listed, three ways.** (1) **The public form** «Vreau să fiu voluntar» opens only while an agreement is in force in every language — a fourth condition, `noAgreement`, after the notice's, and a fifth, `noAgreementNotice`: the notice in force names the acceptance too (below) (`volunteerOfferClosedFor`; the card names the first missing, the action asks again) — and takes two more required ticks: «Am citit și accept contractul de voluntariat», linking the text in force at `/legal/volunteer-agreement` in a new tab, and «Am cel puțin 18 ani». (2) **A person an organizer enters by hand** is «Contract neacceptat încă» on the card until they accept: «Trimite linkul contractului» queues one email whose single-use link is minted at the send (AGENTS.md §12.8, §14.5): only its SHA-256 is kept, on the volunteer's row, with its expiry (the house's 14 days); a newer email's link replaces it, a changed address or a cancellation kills it — and a request queued before an organizer corrected the address is withdrawn at the send, the mint matching the canonical address the email goes to, so the old mailbox never gets a working link (a receipt or a copy queued to it leaves without the PDF); a link whose email the provider refuses for good is cleared, so the card's «Link trimis» never names a link nobody holds; the link's page reads and never writes, and its button spends the link in the same statement that records the acceptance. (3) **On paper at the desk**: «PDF de semnat» prints the agreement filled for the person with the volunteer's and the organizer's signature lines; «Semnat pe hârtie», after a question, records it with the staff member who recorded it — a record of the person's signature, never a signature given for them — and only while the version in force and the person's role are the ones the card printed (it posts both back; otherwise `VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_REPRINT`, «tipărește din nou»); the person is emailed their copy, as after the link; and the age counts as declared on paper only when the signed version states it (`{{minimumAge}}`), since the club may approve a text without that sentence. Every way keeps the same facts on the row (migration `0148_volunteer_agreement`, expand only): the version accepted (`ON DELETE RESTRICT`, and counted among `/admin/legal`'s signatures so a version somebody accepted is never edited or removed as unused), the moment, the way, the language, the blanks as filled (`agreement_facts`, so a role renamed later never changes what was accepted; a role's description loses one closing full stop first, `tasksWords`, never «…kilometrul 5..») and the SHA-256 of the exact text read (§556's `signedTextHash`), with the age declared.

**The PDF.** Drawn by the signed declaration's renderer (§95, §515), no identity document asked: the accepted text, the name in the hand the page showed it in, how and when it was accepted and the two fingerprints; attached to the volunteer's «am primit» after the form and to «Ai acceptat contractul de voluntariat» after the link or the paper, and downloadable from the card (audited, like the declaration's). The card says when the accepted text named another role, or another date or place than the event's now; the acceptance stays valid (a moved race is the organizers' to talk over, and a new acceptance is not forced). The privacy notice's template names the acceptance in its volunteers' paragraph (kept to conclude and perform the agreement, art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), with its own marker, `{{volunteerAgreement}}` (the agreement's title, quoted), the house's pattern (§562, §613, §754): a notice approved from §754's template says nothing of the acceptance, the age statement, the PDF or the link, so the form, «Trimite linkul contractului» and «Semnat pe hârtie» wait for a notice naming it (`VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_NOTICE`); its age is the agreement's, never a number in the notice. `/admin/tasks` gains the rows `volunteerAgreement` (open while an event ahead takes volunteers and no agreement is in force) and `volunteerAgreementNotice` (open while the notice in force does not name the acceptance), each done by itself.

**For the lawyer, not decided here:** whether an electronic acceptance meets the law's written form or the paper copy is needed; minors (15–18 may volunteer with a parent's consent — the platform takes adults only until the lawyer says how); whether the role's description is enough as the task sheet; insurance; and whether a register of agreements must outlive the thirty-day deletion of the volunteers' rows (§754), which takes the acceptances with it — the owner's and the lawyer's to decide before the text is approved (keep a narrowed acceptance record, or send the club an archive copy like `DECLARATION_ARCHIVE`). Until they do, the text promises only what the platform does: «Voluntarul primește pe email o copie a contractului acceptat, ca PDF. Clubul păstrează dovada acceptării cât timp spune nota de confidențialitate.», the copy sent after the form, the link and the paper alike.

**Refused.** A confirmation blocked until the agreement is accepted (the brief asks for the mark, and blocking would stop the club's list in production the day this ships, before any text is approved); an acceptance on a repeated public sign-up (a stranger could accept for a listed address — the link to that address is the way); a token in `email_action_tokens` (it requires a participant, and a volunteer is none: the hash lives on the volunteer's row instead).
changelogLine: - **A volunteer agreement («Contract de voluntariat»)** — a new legal text the club approves in «Documente legale» from the platform's template: unpaid help, what the volunteer and the club each do, ending at any time, Legea nr. 78/2014. «Vreau să fiu voluntar» opens only while it is in force and asks to accept it and «Am cel puțin 18 ani»; a person entered by hand is «Contract neacceptat încă» until they accept from an emailed single-use link or sign the printed copy at the desk; the accepted agreement comes as a PDF by email and from the card. The privacy notice's template names the acceptance with a marker of its own: approve the notice in the same sitting. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event that takes volunteers, when no volunteer agreement is in force in every language, or the privacy notice in force does not name `{{volunteerAgreement}}` in every language, then its page draws no «Vreau să fiu voluntar» and a post is refused (`CONFLICT`); once one is, the form also requires «Am citit și accept contractul de voluntariat» (linking the text in force in a new tab) and «Am cel puțin 18 ani», each refusal named at its box, and a kept offer records the version accepted, the moment, `FORM`, the language, the blanks as filled and the SHA-256 of the filled text (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the legal document keys, then `VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT` is the seventh, last in the enum and on `/admin/legal` in a group of its own, approved by the one press with the others; the seed approves a sample of it everywhere but production; and a version a volunteer accepted counts among its signatures and cannot be deleted under them (`ON DELETE RESTRICT`) (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the volunteer agreement's template, then in both languages it says the help is unpaid and no employment, the volunteer's duties and the club's, that either side may end it at any time, points to the privacy notice and names Legea nr. 78/2014; it carries the club's four facts as placeholders and the merge fields `{{volunteer}}`, `{{volunteerRole}}`, `{{volunteerTasks}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{eventDate}}`, `{{eventLocation}}`, `{{minimumAge}}`, `{{signedAt}}`, a role without a description leaving out the sentence that names it; and it promises only the copy the platform sends — the volunteer's, by email, as a PDF — and the proof kept for as long as the privacy notice says (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer entered by hand, when an organizer presses «Trimite linkul contractului», then one email is queued with no secret in it and the link is minted when it is sent, its SHA-256 alone on the volunteer's row; its page reads and writes nothing; accepting spends it in the statement that records the acceptance (`LINK`), so a second use, an expired link, a link a newer email replaced, one sent to an address changed since and one of a cancelled volunteer all answer the same «no longer valid»; a request still queued when the address changes is withdrawn at the send and mints nothing, and a link whose email is refused for good is cleared (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the event's «Voluntari» card, then each person says «Contract acceptat» with the version, the way and the moment, or «Contract neacceptat încă» with «Trimite linkul contractului», «PDF de semnat» and «Semnat pe hârtie», which records the version in force and the staff member who recorded it, refuses (`VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_REPRINT`) when that version or the person's role is not the one printed, and emails the person their copy; a cancelled person who never accepted shows no agreement chip; the card names «niciun contract de voluntariat nu e în vigoare» as the reason the public form is closed, and `/admin/tasks` shows the row `volunteerAgreement` while an event ahead takes volunteers and none is in force, and `volunteerAgreementNotice` while the notice in force does not name the acceptance; the link and the paper are refused (`VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_NOTICE`) until it does (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer, when their agreement is downloaded from the card or attached to their «am primit» or to «Ai acceptat contractul de voluntariat», then the PDF prints the accepted text with its blanks as accepted, the name, how and when it was accepted and the text's fingerprint — or, not accepted yet, the text in force filled for them with the volunteer's and the organizer's signature lines — and never an identity-document line (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the volunteer agreement's verbs — «Trimite linkul contractului», «Semnat pe hârtie» and the PDF route — when anyone but the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator asks, then the server refuses (`FORBIDDEN` / 403; a request with no session, 401), a volunteer of another event or a malformed id is `NOT_FOUND`, and a refusal writes no audit row while each download writes one with the volunteer's id and never a name (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
